summary: A one-time code input, one slot per character, in three sizes and three shapes.

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the slots, wired to the first one through Base UI's `Field.Label`.

props.name: description
props.example: Sent to your phone, ending in 42.
props.description: A line under the slots, for where the code comes from.

props.name: length
props.description: How many characters the code has, one slot each.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Slots per group, with a dash between groups. `0` draws one unbroken row.

props.name: validationType
props.description: Which characters a slot accepts. Anything else is dropped as it is typed or pasted, and the mobile keyboard follows it.

props.name: mask
props.description: Draws each character as a dot, as a password field does.

props.name: size
props.description: Width, height and type size of every slot.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on each slot. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks input and dims the whole field, label included.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk to the label and makes the code required when a form submits.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline on the slot being typed in. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.label: Verification code
props.description: Sent to your phone, ending in 42
